post.yt_desc:
Nvidia started at a Denny's in 1993 and became the first public company worth $5 trillion in October 2025. In fiscal 2026 it made $215.9 billion of revenue, 91% from data centers, and $120.1 billion of net income, about 56 cents per dollar. We cover the history from GeForce to CUDA to AlexNet, the fabless business model, the numbers from its filings, its CUDA moat, and the risks it lists. No stock tips, just the business model.
